Profit's up. Will the bank lend?

In our view, not on profit alone. Banks look at profit, but they lend on the cash that repays the loan and how well it covers each payment; each bank's criteria differ, so check your facility letter.

Profit is not cash
Slow collections cut the cash that repays debt
Banks look at how cash covers each payment
